text_en: Then what advantage has the Jew? Or what is the value of circumcision?
text_cn: 那么，犹太人有什么优点呢？割损又有什么好处呢？

text_en: Much, in every way. For in the first place the Jews were entrusted with the oracles of God.
text_cn: 从各方面来说，很多：首先，天主的神谕是交托给了他们，

text_en: What if some were unfaithful? Will their faithlessness nullify the faithfulness of God?
text_cn: 他们中纵使有些人不信，又有什么关系呢？难道他们的不信能使天主的忠信失效吗？

text_en: By no means! Although everyone is a liar, let God be proved true, as it is written, “So that you may be justified in your words, and prevail in your judging. ”
text_cn: 断乎不能！天主总是诚实的！众人虚诈不实，正如经上所载：“在你的言语上，你必显出正义；在你受审判时，你必获得胜利。”

text_en: But if our injustice serves to confirm the justice of God, what should we say? That God is unjust to inflict wrath on us? (I speak in a human way. )
text_cn: 但，如果有人说：我们的不义可彰显天主的正义。那我们可说什么呢？难道能说天主发怒惩罚是不义吗？──这是我按俗见说的──

text_en: By no means! For then how could God judge the world?
text_cn: 绝对不是！如果天主不义，他将怎样审判世界呢？

text_en: But if through my falsehood God’s truthfulness abounds to his glory, why am I still being condemned as a sinner?
text_cn: 如果天主的诚实可因我的虚诈越发彰显出来，为使他获得荣耀；那么，为什么我还要被判为罪人呢？

text_en: And why not say (as some people slander us by saying that we say), “Let us do evil so that good may come”? Their condemnation is deserved!
text_cn: 为什么我们不去作恶，为得到善果呢？──有人说我们说过这样的话，为诽谤我们──这样的人被惩罚是理当的。

text_en: What then? Are we any better off? No, not at all; for we have already charged that all, both Jews and Greeks, are under the power of sin,
text_cn: 那么，我们犹太人比外邦人更好吗？决不是的！因为我们早先已说过：不论是犹太人，或是希腊人，都在罪恶权势之下，

text_en: as it is written: “There is no one who is righteous, not even one;
text_cn: 正如经上所载：“没有义人，连一个也没有；

text_en: there is no one who has understanding, there is no one who seeks God.
text_cn: 没有一个明智人，没有寻觅天主的人；

text_en: All have turned aside, together they have become worthless; there is no one who shows kindness, there is not even one. ”
text_cn: 人人都离弃了正道，一同败坏了；没有一人行善，实在没有一个；

text_en: “Their throats are opened graves; they use their tongues to deceive. ” “The venom of vipers is under their lips. ”
text_cn: 他们的咽喉是敞开的坟墓，他们的舌头说出虚诈的言语，他们的双唇下含有蛇毒；

text_en: “Their mouths are full of cursing and bitterness. ”
text_cn: 他们满口是咒言与毒语；

text_en: “Their feet are swift to shed blood;
text_cn: 他们的脚急于倾流人血；

text_en: ruin and misery are in their paths,
text_cn: 在他们的行径上只有蹂躏与困苦；

text_en: and the way of peace they have not known. ”
text_cn: 和平的道路，他们不认识；

text_en: “There is no fear of God before their eyes. ”
text_cn: 他们的眼中，没有敬畏天主之情。”

text_en: Now we know that whatever the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be silenced, and the whole world may be held accountable to God.
text_cn: 我们知道：凡法律所说的，都是对那些属于法律的人说的，为堵塞众人的口，并使全世界都在天主前承认己罪，

text_en: For “no human being will be justified in his sight” by deeds prescribed by the law, for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.
text_cn: 因为没有一个人能因遵守法律，而在他前成义；因为法律只能使人认识罪过。

text_en: But now, apart from law, the righteousness of God has been disclosed, and is attested by the law and the prophets,
text_cn: 但是如今，天主的正义，在法律之外已显示出来；法律和先知也为此作证：

text_en: the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ for all who believe. For there is no distinction,
text_cn: 就是天主的正义，因对耶稣基督的信德，毫无区别地，赐给了凡信仰的人，

text_en: since all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God;
text_cn: 因为所有的人都犯了罪，都失掉了天主的光荣，

text_en: they are now justified by his grace as a gift, through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,
text_cn: 所以众人都因天主白白施给的恩宠，在耶稣基督内蒙救赎，成为义人。

text_en: whom God put forward as a sacrifice of atonement by his blood, effective through faith. He did this to show his righteousness, because in his divine forbearance he had passed over the sins previously committed;
text_cn: 这耶稣即是天主公开立定，使他以自己的血，为信仰他的人作赎罪祭的；如此，天主显示了自己的正义，因为以前他因宽容放过了人的罪，

text_en: it was to prove at the present time that he himself is righteous and that he justifies the one who has faith in Jesus.
text_cn: 为的是在今时显示自己的正义，叫人知道他是正义的，是使信仰耶稣的人成义的天主。

text_en: Then what becomes of boasting? It is excluded. By what law? By that of works? No, but by the law of faith.
text_cn: 既是这样，哪里还有可自夸之处？绝对没有！因了什么制度而没有自夸之处呢？是因法律上的功行吗？不是的！是因信德的制度，

text_en: For we hold that a person is justified by faith apart from works prescribed by the law.
text_cn: 因为我们认为人的成义，是藉信德，而不在于遵行法律。

text_en: Or is God the God of Jews only? Is he not the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,
text_cn: 难道天主只是犹太人的天主吗？不也是外邦人的天主吗？是的，也是外邦人的天主！

text_en: since God is one; and he will justify the circumcised on the ground of faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith.
text_cn: 因为天主只有一个，他使受割损的由于信德而成义，也使未受割损的凭信德而成义。

text_en: Do we then overthrow the law by this faith? By no means! On the contrary, we uphold the law.
text_cn: 那么我们就因信德而废了法律吗？绝对不是！我们反使法律坚固。
